title: Linear polynomial formal fibre hypersurface presentation
statement: Let $A$ be a domain, and let $q,r\subset A[X]$ be prime ideals [def-weil-polynomial-ring] with $r\ne0$ and $r\cap A=0$. Assume the canonical $A$-algebra $\kappa(r)$ [def-weil-pbc-localization-at-prime] is a fraction field of $A$. Let $C=(A[X]_q)^\wedge$ be the maximal-ideal-adic completion [def-weil-pbc-adic-completion], and set $R=\kappa(0_A)\otimes_A C$. There exist $f\in R$ and an absolute derivation $D:R\to R$ such that $D(f)=1$ and $R/(f)\cong\kappa(r)\otimes_{A[X]}C$ as rings. An absolute derivation is additive and satisfies the Leibniz rule; it is represented by an integer derivation in Lean. No regularity assertion or Noetherianity assumption occurs.

proof.text: Let K be the residue field of the zero prime of A and let e : κ(r) ≃ₐ[A] K be the canonical equivalence of fraction fields (IsLocalization.algEquiv). Set ξ=e(X), x=the image of X in C, and f=1 tensor x - ξ tensor 1. Apply the proved general linear-fibre quotient theorem to S=C to obtain R/(f) ≃ r.Fiber C. The quotient proof uses direct inverse tensor maps and polynomial algebra-map extensionality.

Restrict Polynomial.derivative′ to an absolute integer derivation. Extend to A[X]_q using IsLocalization.extendDerivation, then to the maximal-ideal-adic completion C using Derivation.exists_completion_and_unique_localization. By IsLocalization.tensorRight, R=K tensor over A with C is a localization of C at the images of nonzero coefficients. Extend the derivation to R. The extension equalities give D(1 tensor x)=1 and show it annihilates the image of A.

The maps K → R given by k ↦ D(k tensor 1) and by k ↦ 0 satisfy the Leibniz rule along the inclusion K → R and agree on A. Localization derivation uniqueness makes them equal. Hence D(ξ tensor 1)=0. By additivity D(f)=1. Combine this with the quotient equivalence from step 1.

lean.statement: theorem linear_formalFiber_hypersurface (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [IsDomain A] (q : Ideal (Polynomial A)) [q.IsPrime] (r : Ideal (Polynomial A)) [r.IsPrime] [IsFractionRing A r.ResidueField] (hr : r ≠ ⊥) (hrA : r.comap (Polynomial.C : A →+* Polynomial A) = ⊥) : let C := AdicCompletion (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (Localization.AtPrime q)) (Localization.AtPrime q) let R := (⊥ : Ideal A).Fiber C letI : CommSemiring R := (inferInstance : CommRing R).toCommSemiring letI : AddCommMonoid R := (inferInstance : CommRing R).toAddCommGroup.toAddCommMonoid letI : Algebra ℤ R := Ring.toIntAlgebra R ∃ (f : R) (D : Derivation ℤ R R), D f = 1 ∧ Nonempty ((R ⧸ Ideal.span ({f} : Set R)) ≃+* r.Fiber C)
